'''Shallow March Supply Post''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] supply post that was located in the far reaches of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tarn Innis/Legends|Tarn Innis]].
